The value of ADA membership

The Australian Dental Association provides members with valuable support, national advocacy, and connection to a professional community. We empower our members to thrive in an evolving professional landscape to shape the future of dentistry. Explore the benefits of membership.

Membership with the ADA ensures exclusive access to a range of valuable tools, practical resources and expert advice. We help our members deliver high-quality care to patients while developing their careers and staying ahead in our evolving profession.

In the spirit of reconciliation, the ADA acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of Country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea, and community. We pay our respect to their Elders' past, present and future and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.

About ADA

The primary objectives of the Australian Dental Association are to encourage the improvement of the oral and general health of the public, promote the ethics, art and science of dentistry and support members to provide safe, high quality professional oral care.
